title: ThermVision-DB Evaluation Audit: Reproducibility Repository
description: Reproducibility and frozen result-verification materials for the manuscript 'Protocol Sensitivity in Synthetic Thermal Video Face Recognition: An Evaluation Audit of ThermVision-DB'. The repository contains verification scripts, provenance records, and derived result exports; it excludes raw ThermVision-DB media and pretrained model weights.
